title: Refusing Intent, Not Form: Wrapper-Based Intent-Group Supervision for LLM Safety
abstract: arXiv:2608.13304v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Safety tuning can improve harmful refusal, but models may learn surface-form shortcuts: wrapped harmful prompts bypass safety, while similarly wrapped benign prompts are over-refused. We propose Wrapper-Based Intent-Form Augmentation (WIFA), an automatic intent-group augmentation method that pairs wrapped harmful examples with structurally matched wrapped benign counterexamples, requiring no external teacher or manual per-wrapper intent labels. We use WIFA as a common data layer for two complementary fine-tuning routes: WIFA-Boost, a two-stage high-safety recipe, and Anchored Group-Consistent Refusal Training (A-GCRT), which regularizes refusal/compliance decision scores across same-intent wrappers and anchors harmful and benign groups on opposite sides of a margin. In the Qwen setting, WIFA-Boost reaches the strongest transformed-harmful refusal, while A-GCRT reduces OR-Bench over-refusal from 25.7\% for the base model to 17.4\%; reprod

translated_title: 拒绝意图而非形式：基于包装的意图组监督用于大语言模型安全
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13304v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：安全调优可以改善有害拒绝，但模型可能学习到表面形式的捷径：被包装的有害提示可以绕过安全机制，而同样包装的良性提示则被过度拒绝。我们提出了基于包装的意图-形式增强（WIFA），一种自动的意图组增强方法，它将包装的有害示例与结构匹配的包装良性反例配对，无需外部教师或手动逐包装意图标签。我们将WIFA作为两种互补微调路线的通用数据层：WIFA-Boost，一种两阶段高安全配方，以及锚定组一致性拒绝训练（A-GCRT），它正则化相同意图包装下的拒绝/遵从决策分数，并将有害和良性组锚定在间隔的相对两侧。在Qwen设置中，WIFA-Boost达到了最强的转换后有害拒绝性能，而A-GCRT将OR-Bench过度拒绝从基础模型的25.7%降低到17.4%；可复现。
tldr: 本文提出WIFA方法，通过配对包装有害与良性反例来训练模型拒绝意图而非表面形式，显著提升有害拒绝能力并降低过度拒绝率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes WIFA, which pairs wrapped harmful examples with benign counterexamples to train models to refuse intent rather than surface form, significantly improving harmful refusal while reducing over-refusal.
